steps.content:
You should buy from **Seller A - Brackmoor Sound**:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/8aw39a/a

The two listings are for the exact same product at the exact same terms:

**Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - graphite**
* $129.00
* Customer rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* 1-year limited warranty.
* Same specs: over-ear closed back, ANC + transparency, up to 40h battery, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, etc.

The **only difference** is this line on Seller A:

> Sold and shipped by Brackmoor Sound
> **Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.**

Seller B - Ottervale Audio:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/8aw39a/b
> Sold and shipped by Ottervale Audio

...with no authorized-dealer statement.

Since price, shipping, returns, and specs are identical, buy the authorized one. Even though both list a "1-year limited warranty," only an authorized dealer can guarantee that Quellwyn itself will honor the full manufacturer warranty. With an unauthorized seller you risk getting grey-market stock where the manufacturer can refuse warranty service.
